title: NEI Enchantments
description: A lightweight and powerful enchantment utility mod for Minecraft 1.21.1, inspired by the classic Not Enough Items (NEI) 'X' key feature. It allows players in Creative mode to quickly enchant items with a modern and intuitive GUI.
body:
**NEI Enchantments** is a lightweight Fabric mod that brings the classic **Not Enough Items (NEI)** **X key enchantment** feature to modern Minecraft. Hover over an item in your inventory, press **X**, and apply enchantments through a simple GUI.

---

## Features

- **Quick access:** Hover over an item in your inventory and press **X** to open the enchantment menu
- **Smart filtering:** Only enchantments compatible with that item are listed
- **High levels:** Most enchantments can be applied up to **level 10** (single-level enchantments stay at max 1)
- **Real-time sync:** Changes are validated on the server — no item duplication
- **Modern GUI:** Search, scrollable list, level slider, Apply / Remove buttons
- **All game modes:** Works in Survival, Hardcore, and Creative
- **JEI support:** If JEI is installed, usage guides and custom enchantment descriptions appear in the Information tab (optional)
- **English & Turkish** localization

---

## Custom enchantments

- **Vein Miner** — Pickaxes  
  Breaks connected ores of the same type (up to 60 blocks). Includes Nether quartz.

- **Tree Feller** — Axes  
  When you break a log, chops all connected logs, then only leaves linked to that tree.

Both enchantments are applied through the NEI enchantment menu (X key).

---

## Keybindings

- **X** — Open enchantment menu (configurable in settings)

---

## Installation

1. Install **Fabric Loader** and **Fabric API** (Minecraft **26.2**)
2. Place the **NEI Enchantments** jar in your `mods` folder
3. (Optional) Add the **JEI** jar
4. Launch the game

---

## Requirements

- Minecraft **26.2**
- Fabric Loader **0.19.3+**
- Fabric API
- Java **25+**

---

*NEI Enchantments is inspired by chickenbones’ original Not Enough Items mod.*
